source: Balluff user's guide BNI EIP-508-105-Z015-C06 (order code BNI007C): '508 = IP 67 IO-Link Master-Module, 8 IO-Link ports'; 'ports 0-3 and 4-7 IN / OUT / IO-Link'; 'IP 67 (only when plugged-in and threaded-in)'; 'Dimensions (W x H x D in mm) 68 x 224 x 37.9'. The guide never states 'class A'; port_class A is read from the pinout '5 n.a.' and the 4-pin 7/8" supply (no aux supply). Vendor ID and IO-Link spec version not stated.
